en.headline: CHP investigates probable botulism after Tsim Sha Tsui injections
en.dek: A 35-year-old woman is in stable condition after developing drooping eyelids, breathing difficulty and limb weakness following facial injections in a Middle Road flat.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Monday it is investigating a probable case of botulism after a 35-year-old woman received facial injections said to be botulinum toxin at a residential flat on Middle Road in Tsim Sha Tsui.

According to information the patient provided, she visited the unit, in Far East Mansion, on 17 September and was injected in both sides of the forehead, the area between the eyebrows and beneath the chin. She told the Centre she believed the person who administered the injections was a registered doctor, but she could not confirm the individual's name or qualifications.

The following day she developed drooping eyelids, difficulty breathing and weakness in all four limbs and attended the Accident and Emergency Department at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. She was admitted and remains in a stable condition. Clinicians consider the symptoms consistent with botulism linked to a botulinum toxin injection. Epidemiological work is continuing. The Centre said it suspected unlicensed medical practice and referred the matter to police.

The Centre reiterated that in Hong Kong botulinum toxin should be prescribed and injected only by a locally registered doctor after a clinical assessment. It advised the public to check a practitioner's full name against the Medical Council of Hong Kong register and to refuse injections from uncertain sources, which may be contaminated or incorrectly dosed.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查尖沙嘴注射後疑肉毒中毒個案
zh.dek: 一名35歲女子在中間道住宅單位接受面部注射後出現眼瞼下垂、呼吸困難及四肢無力，現時情況穩定。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周一表示，正調查一宗注射肉毒桿菌毒素後出現肉毒中毒的疑似個案，涉及一名35歲女病人。她在尖沙嘴中間道遠東大廈一個住宅單位內接受面部注射。
根據病人提供的資料，她於9月17日在該單位接受現場人員在額頭兩側、眉間及下頸位置注射報稱是肉毒桿菌毒素的針劑。病人表示相信負責注射的人員為註冊醫生，但未能確認對方姓名及資歷。
她於9月18日因眼瞼下垂、呼吸困難及四肢無力到伊利沙伯醫院急症室求診，其後留院，目前情況穩定。臨床診斷懷疑她因注射肉毒桿菌毒素而引致肉毒桿菌中毒。流行病學調查仍在進行。中心表示懷疑有人涉無牌行醫，已轉交警方跟進。
中心提醒，在香港注射肉毒桿菌毒素只應由本地註冊醫生經臨床評估後處方及施行。市民應核對醫生全名是否載於香港醫務委員會註冊醫生名單，並查詢其專業資格。來源不明的針劑可能混雜雜質或劑量不準，應拒絕接受。
